channel.title: Robotics Directory - Companion Robots
channel.description: Browse 94 companion robots in the Robotics Directory. Specs, prices, images and comparison.

item.title: Tombot Jennie
item.description: Realistic robotic Labrador puppy designed as an emotional-support companion for people who cannot care for a live pet.

item.title: Robopoet Fuzozo
item.description: Wearable furry AI companion charm, five-element personalities, multimodal emotion interaction, 120k+ sold

item.title: Tuya Smart Aura
item.description: Autonomous AI pet companion with laser play, feeding and emotion analysis.

item.title: Ludens AI Cocomo
item.description: Wheeled warm-touch AI pet that follows owners and hums instead of speaking.

item.title: Ludens AI Inu
item.description: Desktop AI pet with wagging tail and blinking single eye reacting to touch.

item.title: InsBotics Pophie
item.description: Evolving 5-DOF AI companion with long-term memory, gaze tracking and 12 languages.

item.title: Gogobot D1
item.description: Camera-free AI robot dog doing tricks with ToF sensors and voice conversation.

item.title: ZBy – Mind with Heart An'An
item.description: AI panda companion, also called AnAn. European launch announced September 3, 2026 with distributors in Germany and Belgium and September sales planned. Manufacturer quotes overseas retail pricing of 1,000–1,500 USD; this is not a confirmed German EUR price.

item.title: OLLOBOT OlloNi
item.description: OlloNi SS1, presented at IFA 2026 on September 5, is a mobile AI companion with household-member recognition and adaptive memory. The manufacturer postponed its late-August Kickstarter campaign; no replacement date was announced. Existing OlloNi catalog identity retained to avoid a duplicate.

item.title: Qiyuan Q1 Explorer
item.description: Personal robot from Qiyuan's Q1 line, shown in Explorer form around WAIC 2026 as part of the company's consumer robot lineup.

item.title: Qiyuan T1
item.description: Transformable personal robot from Qiyuan that can switch between wheel-legged humanoid-style movement and quadruped form for consumer companion use.

item.title: AheadForm Origin F1
item.description: Desktop ultra-bionic humanoid head for real-world interaction; vision and voice perception, face recognition, speech, dialogue and coordinated facial expressions across 26 DoF in the head, eyes and face modules.

item.title: AheadForm Elf Xuan
item.description: Bionic robotic head focused on stable long-term interaction, brand display, reception and emotional interaction; performed at Zhiyuan Robotics' Robot Wonder Night in 2026.

item.title: PrimeBOT Q1
item.description: Compact personal robot and embodied-intelligence creation platform from PrimeBOT, aimed at developers, educators and technology enthusiasts with expressive full-body motion and emotionally responsive interaction.

item.title: Tuya Smart Doova
item.description: Mobile home companion unveiled September 4, 2026 for independently living seniors. Tuya describes LiDAR navigation, voice interaction, reminders and smart-home coordination. Commercial availability and price were not announced.

item.title: Takway AI Sweekar
item.description: Egg-shaped, palm-sized AI pocket pet (a physical Tamagotchi successor) that grows through egg, baby, teen and adult stages based on interaction XP, with long-term voice and activity memory. Unveiled at CES 2026 and crowdfunded on Kickstarter. Takway AI was founded in Shenzhen in 2024.

item.title: SwitchBot KATA Friends
item.description: AI pet robot sold in two characters (Noa and Niko). Its on-device AI reacts to the owner's sleep patterns, mood and presence and keeps working offline. It moves around the home to greet people at the door, dances to music and responds to gestures. Optional care plans are sold separately.

item.title: Robosen Flagship Soundwave
item.description: Licensed Transformers G1 Soundwave robot that converts itself into a cassette-player form and doubles as a Bluetooth speaker. It has 28 servos, 48 voice commands and more than 200 lines recorded by the original voice actor. The app offers joystick control and free programming.

item.title: ECOVACS LilMilo
item.description: ECOVACS' first emotional AI companion robot (FAMIBOT line), shaped like a small plush dog. It recognises faces, gestures and voices and has five personality types and seven core emotions. Its expressive eyes and articulated head react to touch, and it can mimic voices. The camera switches off in sleep mode and images are stored on the device. Shown at CES 2026 and launched in May 2026.

item.title: CyboPal ONE
item.description: Desktop robotic terminal whose display moves on its own: it follows the user and switches between landscape and portrait. It is controlled by voice and gesture and works with AI agents to complete tasks. The Kickstarter campaign launched September 22, 2026.

item.title: Pollen Robotics Reachy Mini
item.description: Open-source expressive desktop robot available in Lite and autonomous Wireless versions with a wide-angle camera and microphone array.

item.title: Ropet Ropet
item.description: Furry AI desk pet; camera+screen eyes, face/emotion/gesture recognition, ChatGPT voice, 2h battery

item.title: Yukai Engineering Nékojita FuFu
item.description: Clip-on cat mini robot that blows air to cool hot food/drinks; Fu-ing algorithm, USB-C rechargeable

item.title: Yukai Engineering Mirumi
item.description: Furry bag-charm robot that shyly peeks at passersby; motion/proximity sensors, head-swivel reactions

item.title: Mixi Romi (Lacatan)
item.description: Palm-size conversational AI robot; real-time interjecting chat in JP/EN, camera scene talk, CES 2025 honoree

item.title: LivingAI AIBI Pocket
item.description: Pocket AI pet; rotating camera, 3-mic array, mmWave radar, face/voice recognition, ChatGPT, NFC

item.title: TCL Ai Me
item.description: Modular owl-like AI companion concept; swappable cores/bases, emotion recognition, Matter smart-home control

item.title: Sharp Poketomo
item.description: 12 cm meerkat AI buddy; OpenAI-powered chat, 5MP camera photo diary, Wi-Fi/BT 5.0, 200 g

item.title: Emotix Miko Mini
item.description: Affordable Indian AI companion robot for kids with STEAM games and parental controls.

item.title: X-Origin AI Yonbo X1
item.description: Multimodal ChatGPT-powered family companion robot with 5MP vision and 600+ expressions.

item.title: OhYou Technology OUROBOT
item.description: ChatGPT desktop companion with OU-Brain emotional AI, voice mood detection and nodding.

item.title: Jizai Mi-Mo
item.description: Six-legged Pixar-lamp-like general-purpose AI companion robot and developer kit.

item.title: FoloToy Kumma
item.description: GPT-4o teddy bear plush toy with removable Wi-Fi AI conversation module.

item.title: Ling Technology Ling!
item.description: Spatial interactive AI learning companion for children aged three to twelve.

item.title: AheadForm Origin M1
item.description: Character-focused bionic head developed with NetEase Games; 30 movable facial muscle units, 12 micro-expressions, dual-camera eye tracking, temperature-controlled bionic skin and character-level AI interaction.

item.title: Huawei Smart Hanhan
item.description: Palm-sized plush AI emotional companion with circular eye displays, powered by Huawei's Xiaoyi large model; reacts to voice, touch and shaking and keeps an interaction diary. Launched in China alongside the Mate 80 series and sold out at launch.

item.title: Ogmen Robotics ORo
item.description: Pet companion robot, mobile app control, interactive pet engagement

item.title: Limitbit Doly
item.description: Raspberry Pi CM4 tracked desk robot; 8MP camera, on-device ML, face/gesture recognition, open hardware

item.title: TangibleFuture LOOI
item.description: Turns smartphone into desk robot; ChatGPT, face/gesture tracking, cliff sensors, 15W wireless charging

item.title: Intuition Robotics ElliQ 3
item.description: ElliQ is Intuition Robotics' AI care companion for older adults. The manufacturer describes a stationary device with an integrated screen, proactive conversation, shared activities and a Relationship Orchestrator that combines multiple LLMs with context, memory, goals and real-time guardrails. The January 9, 2024 announcement identifies ElliQ 3 as a lighter hardware generation with a 36% smaller footprint, a fully integrated screen and a MediaTek octa-core plus AI chip SoC. It says the generative-AI software upgrade is compatible with all ElliQ hardware versions, while ElliQ 3 hardware was expected in spring 2024. The company reports loneliness, health and social-connection outcomes and describes a leased membership service; the reviewed pages publish no numeric price, mass, dimensions, battery runtime or independent clinical certification.

item.title: Haivivi BubblePal
item.description: Bubble-shaped AI toy that clips onto plush toys; LLM chat, long-term memory, multilingual, 4h battery

item.title: Robosen Buzz Lightyear Space Ranger Alpha
item.description: Programmable 42cm Buzz Lightyear robot with 23 servos and voice interaction.

item.title: Casio Moflin
item.description: AI companion with touch, light, microphone and motion sensors that develops a unique simulated emotional personality.

item.title: Groove X LOVOT 3.0
item.description: Third-generation emotional care robot with an upgraded NVIDIA Jetson brain, 50+ sensors, a thermography camera, and multi-layered OLED eyes for lifelike warmth.

item.title: Robosen Flagship Megatron
item.description: Licensed Transformers Megatron robot that converts itself between tank and robot forms. It has 36 servos and 112 LEDs, more than 270 voice lines and over 50 voice commands. It offers five programming modes (block, voice, manual, easy and PC). Made with Hasbro.

item.title: Ortomi Companion Gen 4
item.description: 40g pocket cube pet; 7 moods, 40+ expressions, reacts to touch/shake, custom faces via Ortomi Workshop

item.title: Curio Grok
item.description: Screen-free AI plush rocket toy voiced by Grimes with conversational voice box.

item.title: Curio Grem
item.description: Cloud-connected AI plush companion toy for kids with conversational voice box.

item.title: Wonderful Platform Dasom
item.description: ChatGPT-powered senior care companion robot with screen and health monitoring.

item.title: navel robotics navel
item.description: navel is a social robot from Munich for nursing homes. It uses LLM-based conversation in 74 languages, recognizes faces and emotions, remembers past conversations and has expressive 3D-lens eyes. It runs on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier with lidar, sonar and depth sensing. A pre-series pilot has run in German care homes since October 2023.
